The '''Diab system''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It contained the planet [[Diab]], as well as its moon [[Diab 6]]. It was the site of the secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[the Prism]], also known as the Ghost Prison.
